name: ABO Desire
description: When an arrogant Alpha infiltrates a rival’s company and falls for a seemingly delicate Omega, he’s pulled into a dangerous game that challenges everything he knows.

videos.title: The Beautiful New Secretary
videos.overview: After a viral-era power shift, Shaoyou meets Hua Yong, an alluring Omega tied to HS Group, sparking danger and desire.

videos.title: Night Work
videos.overview: Shaoyou rescues Hua Yong at a club and secretly pays his sister’s bills, drawing them closer as trust slowly grows.

videos.title: The New Home
videos.overview: As Hua Yong moves in, Shaoyou’s steady care deepens their bond, revealing feelings that go far beyond friendship.

videos.title: The Classmate on My Mind
videos.overview: Hua Yong’s rule on permanent marking shocks Shaoyou as business tensions rise and Gao Tu’s hidden struggle surfaces.

videos.title: The Pheromone Showdown
videos.overview: Shaoyou and Hua Yong reconcile, but after rejecting marking and going missing, Hua Yong’s true identity emerges.

videos.title: I Can’t Leave You
videos.overview: Hua Yong’s role behind X Holdings is exposed, and Shaoyou brings him back, choosing to fight HS Group to protect him.

videos.title: The Unexpected Two
videos.overview: Hua Yong’s overdose lands him in the hospital, and a tense dinner clash with Shen Wenlang ignites new conflict.

videos.title: Lucky Star
videos.overview: Shaoyou collapses from pheromone loss, and at an X Holdings gathering chaos erupts as he suddenly falls into a coma.

videos.title: The Scent Filling the Hotel
videos.overview: Hua Yong’s risky schemes spark heartbreak when he loses control, while Gao Tu’s slip reveals his hidden Omega identity.

videos.title: Let’s Go Home Together
videos.overview: Hua Yong’s risky schemes spark heartbreak when he loses control, while Gao Tu’s slip reveals his hidden Omega identity.

videos.title: We’ll Meet Again, Right?
videos.overview: Shaoyou learns Hua Yong once soothed him while wounded, yet suspicions grow as a hidden plot forms against Shaoyou.

videos.title: You’re Mine
videos.overview: Kidnapped and poisoned, Shaoyou is saved when Hua Yong marks him as Enigma, while Gao Tu’s resignation sparks turmoil.

videos.title: A Kind Person
videos.overview: Gao Tu faces pregnancy alone as Hua Yong’s long-hidden identity and devotion leave Shaoyou stunned and uncertain.

videos.title: A Reward for Studying
videos.overview: Shaoyou and Hua Yong grow closer, but Shaoqing’s schemes push Hua Yong to step in and shield the one he loves.

videos.title: I’m Pregnant
videos.overview: Both hospitalized, Shaoyou discovers he’s pregnant, while Gao Tu cuts ties, forcing Wenlang to face his true feelings.

videos.title: Unstoppable Desire and Love
videos.overview: Shaoyou accepts Hua Yong’s proposal, and years later they raise a child as Wenlang finally reunites with Gao Tu.
